pairs: Congregatus est igitur omnis Israël ad David in Hebron,
Then all of Israel was gathered to David at Hebron,
et nudiustertius cum adhuc regnaret Saul,
you were the one who led out and brought in Israel.
tibi enim dixit Dominus Deus tuus:
For the Lord your God said to you:
et tu eris princeps super eum.
and you shall be the leader over them.’”
Venerunt ergo omnes majores natu Israël ad regem in Hebron,
Therefore, all those greater by birth of Israel went to the king at Hebron.
et iniit David cum eis fœdus coram Domino:
And David formed a pact with them before the Lord.
And they anointed him king over Israel,
juxta sermonem Domini quem locutus est in manu Samuel.
in accord with the word of the Lord, which he spoke by the hand of Samuel.
Abiit quoque David et omnis Israël in Jerusalem:
Then David and all of Israel went to Jerusalem.
where the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were.
Dixeruntque qui habitabant in Jebus ad David:
And those who were living in Jebus said to David:
But David seized the stronghold of Zion,
which is the city of David.
Omnis qui percusserit Jebusæum in primis,
Ascendit igitur primus Joab filius Sarviæ,
And so Joab, the son of Zeruiah, ascended first,
and he was made the leader.
Then David lived in the stronghold,
et idcirco appellata est civitas David.
and for this reason it was called the City of David.
Ædificavitque urbem in circuitu a Mello usque ad gyrum;
And he built up the city all around, from Millo even to every side.
But Joab built the rest of the city.
And David continued advancing and increasing,
et Dominus exercituum erat cum eo.
and the Lord of hosts was with him.
These are the leaders of the strong men of David,
qui adjuverunt eum ut rex fieret super omnem Israël,
who assisted him, so that he would become king over all of Israel,
juxta verbum Domini quod locutus est ad Israël.
in accord with the word of the Lord, which he spoke to Israel.
And this is the number of the robust of David:
Jesbaam filius Hachamoni princeps inter triginta:
Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, leader among the thirty.
iste levavit hastam suam super trecentos vulneratos una vice.
He lifted up his spear over three hundred, who were wounded at one time.
Et post eum Eleazar filius patrui ejus Ahohites,
And after him, there was Eleazar, the son of his uncle,
an Ahohite, who was among the three powerful ones.
Iste fuit cum David in Phesdomim,
He was with David in Pasdammim,
quando Philisthiim congregati sunt ad locum illum in prælium:
when the Philistines were gathered to that place for battle.
et erat ager regionis illius plenus hordeo,
Now the field of that region was full of barley,
but the people had fled from the face of the Philistines.
These men stood in the midst of the field,
And when they had struck down the Philistines,
dedit Dominus salutem magnam populo suo.
the Lord gave a great salvation to his people.
Descenderunt autem tres de triginta principibus ad petram, in qua erat David,
Then three from the thirty leaders descended to the rock where David was,
quando Philisthiim fuerant castrametati in valle Raphaim.
when the Philistines had made camp in the Valley of the Rephaim.
Now David was in a stronghold,
and a garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem.
O si quis daret mihi aquam de cisterna Bethlehem,
“O if only someone would give me water from the well of Bethlehem,
Tres ergo isti per media castra Philisthinorum perrexerunt,
Therefore, these three broke through to the midst of the camp of the Philistines,
et hauserunt aquam de cisterna Bethlehem quæ erat in porta,
and they drew water from the well of Bethlehem, which was at the gate. And they took it to David,
et attulerunt ad David ut biberet.
so that he might drink. But he was not willing;
he offered it as a libation to the Lord,
Absit ut in conspectu Dei mei hoc faciam,
“Far be it from me, that I would do this in the sight of my God,
and that I would drink the blood of these men.
quia in periculo animarum suarum attulerunt mihi aquam.
For at the peril of their own lives, they brought the water to me.”
Et ob hanc causam noluit bibere:
And for this reason, he was not willing to drink.
The three most powerful accomplished these things.
Abisai quoque frater Joab ipse erat princeps trium, et ipse levavit hastam suam contra trecentos vulneratos, et ipse erat inter tres nominatissimus,
Also, Abishai, the brother of Joab, was the leader of the three, and he lifted up his spear against three hundred, who were wounded. And he was most renowned among the three,
and he was famous among the second three and their leader.
verumtamen usque ad tres primos non pervenerat.
he did not reach as far as the first three.
Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, from Kabzeel,
qui multa opera perpetrarat, de Cabseel:
was a very mature man, who had accomplished many deeds.
He struck down the two lions of God from Moab.
et ipse descendit et interfecit leonem in media cisterna tempore nivis.
And he descended and killed a lion in the middle of a pit, in the time of snow.
And he struck down an Egyptian man,
et habebat lanceam ut liciatorium texentium:
and who had a spear like a weaver’s beam.
descendit igitur ad eum cum virga,
And yet he descended to him with a staff.
et rapuit hastam quam tenebat manu,
And he seized the spear that he was holding in his hand.
And he killed him with his own spear.
These things were done by Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada,
qui erat inter tres robustos nominatissimus,
who was most renowned among the three robust ones,
verumtamen ad tres usque non pervenerat:
Yet truly, he did not reach as far as the three.
posuit autem eum David ad auriculam suam.
Then David placed him beside his ear.
Moreover, the strongest men of the army were Asahel,
et Elchanan filius patrui ejus de Bethlehem,
and Elhanan, the son of his uncle, from Bethlehem;
Ira, the son of Ikkesh, a Tekoite;
Heled, the son of Baanah, a Netophathite;
Ethai filius Ribai de Gabaath filiorum Benjamin, Banaia Pharatonites,
Ithai, the son of Ribai, from Gibeah, of the sons of Benjamin; Benaiah, a Pirathonite;
The sons of Hashem, a Gizonite:
Jonathan, the son of Shagee, a Hararite;
Ahiam, the son of Sachar, a Hararite;
Naharai Berothites armiger Joab filii Sarviæ,
a Beerothite, the armor bearer of Joab, the son of Zeruiah;
Adina filius Siza Rubenites princeps Rubenitarum, et cum eo triginta:
Adina, the son of Shiza, a Reubenite, the leader of the Reubenites, and thirty who were with him;
Ozia Astarothites, Samma, et Jehiel filii Hotham Arorites,
Uzzia, an Ashterathite; Shama and Jeiel, the sons of Hotham, an Aroerite;
and Joha, his brother, a Tizite;
et Jeribai, et Josaia filii Elnaëm,
and Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam;
